text:
alex: Quick sync on eu-zrh cutover plan — target cutover window tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need to confirm KMS key, VPC peering, DNS routing, and smoke tests. @meera @simon
meera: KMS ticket created: INFRA-4321 (waiting infra approval). ETA end of day. I'll escalate if approver doesn't respond.
simon: Routing PR is up (infra/routing repo) PR #812 — modifies policy tags for residency and adds eu-zrh fallback mapping. Need eng-platform review. @maria can you take a look?
maria: Will review first thing AM. Quick question: do we have a canary model variant decided for initial traffic?
timothy: I'm owning model routing for the cutover. Plan is: 10% canary -> 90% routed to new pool, fallback to quant-small if capacity spikes. I'll add the canary policy and metrics hooks.
alex: Ownership recap: KMS -> meera, Networking/VPC peering -> rajiv, Routing PR + telemetry -> simon/timothy, Review -> maria, Cutover coordinator -> alex. Anyone disagree?
rajiv: Peering slot booked for 2026-05-02 02:00 UTC. Firewall rules list posted in the ticket. Need certs for egress IPs still.
meera: Infra approval delayed because approver is OOO, pinging @lena to expedite. :pray:
lena: Approved now, KMS key provisioning started. deploy-bot will emit job events.
deploy-bot: job eu-zrh-kms-provision started (job-id: zrh-20260502-01) — track at CI dashboard.
alex: Great. Dependencies checklist (short): 1) KMS key provisioned 2) VPC peering + firewall 3) DNS route updates + TTL reduction 4) PR merged + routing rollout 5) smoke tests green.
simon: Note: PR touches route-policy-operator; will need eng-sre signoff on rollback runbook. Pinging SRE.
eng-sre-bot: Created ticket SRE-778 for runbook + alert tuning. Assigned to eng-sre oncall.
maria: Added a short smoke test matrix to the cutover doc: https://confluence.redwood/region-cutovers/eu-zrh-smoke (tests: ingress, prefix cache, kv-cache warm, latency SLO check).
rajiv: Certs team acknowledged request, expect certs issued within 6 hours.
lena: I'll follow up on cert issuance and confirm once available.
alex: Action items assigned: alex -> final checklist and playbook publish, meera -> confirm KMS ready, rajiv -> peering + certs, simon -> get eng-sre signoff, timothy -> config & canary policy. Target: 2 hours pre-cutover final sync.
meera: If infra approval stalls again, I'll escalate to platform ops.
alex: Any other blockers?
rajiv: Nothing else from networking side.
maria: LGTM on the routing changes pending minor comment. I'll approve after CI passes.
alex: OK closing thread — will post final go/no-go 2 hours before window. Ping here if anything breaks. :white_check_mark:
